description: This file defines a high-level data structure, 'ImageHeader', representing metadata about a PNG image within the PDFsharp library's PNG processing component. It includes properties such as dimensions, bit depth, color type, compression, filtering, and interlacing methods, along with validation logic in its constructor.

classes.name: ImageHeader
classes.description: A read-only structure encapsulating PNG image metadata such as dimensions, color information, and processing methods.

methods.name: ImageHeader
methods.description: Constructor that initializes an ImageHeader instance with validation of parameters.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ImageHeader instance, summarizing its properties.
